git_revision.description: The git commit the binary was built from, when known.

load_failures.description: Module files that failed to load.

tools.description: External tools modules and conversions rely on.

upstream_ref.description: The upstream ref the Lua tree follows (e.g. `master`).

upstream_sha.description: The upstream commit the Lua tree was last synced to.

AccountInfo.description: A module's account. The password is never returned; `has_password` says whether one is set.

AccountRequest.description:
The fields to change; a missing field keeps its value. Not `Debug`, so the password cannot
be logged.

AccountStateChange.description: An account's status changed (`account.state`): a login started or finished.

AddFavorite.description: A series to add to the library.

save_to.description:
The download directory; the default one when missing. The manga folder is added when
generated.

downloaded.description: Whether the chapter was downloaded before.

ids.description: These favorites; every enabled favorite when missing.

always_start_from_failed_chapters.description:
Restart a task from its failed chapters (`connections/AlwaysStartFromFailedChapters`,
baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:137).

auto_retry_failed_tasks.description:
Times a failed task is restarted automatically (`connections/NumberOfAutoRetryFailedTask`,
`OptionRetryFailedTask` = 1, baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:136). Range 0..=100, the TSpinEdit default (no bounds
set, mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.lfm:3669-3681).

flaresolverr_url.description:
FlareSolverr's URL, e.g. `http://flaresolverr:8191`, for Cloudflare challenges; empty
for none. No FMD2 setting: FMD2r writes it into upstream's
`lua/websitebypass/websitebypass_config.json` at startup
([`write_websitebypass_config`](super::write_websitebypass_config)).

max_parallel_tasks.description:
Tasks downloading at once, over all modules (`connections/NumberOfTasks`,
`OptionMaxParallel` = 1, baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:133). Range 1..=64: the Win64
`MAX_TASKLIMIT` (baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:42), so any FMD2 value imports.

max_update_list_threads.description:
Threads updating manga lists (`connections/MaxUpdateListThreads`,
baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:131). Range 1..=32 (mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.lfm:3827-3828).

threads_per_task.description:
Page download threads per task (`connections/NumberOfThreadsPerTask`, `OptionMaxThreads`
= 1, baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:134). Range 1..=256: the Win64 `MAX_CONNECTIONPERHOSTLIMIT`
(baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:43).

timeout_secs.description:
Connection timeout in seconds (`connections/ConnectionTimeout`, `OptionConnectionTimeout`
= 30, baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:129). Range 1..=300
(mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.lfm:3387-3388).

user_agent.description:
Default user agent; an empty value resets to [`DEFAULT_USER_AGENT`]
(`connections/DefaultUserAgent`, mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.pas:5867-5871).
user_agent.default: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/133.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

CoverSettings.description:
The cover proxy's disk cache (`/api/covers`). No FMD2 counterpart: FMD2 keeps the one cover it
shows in memory (baseunits/uGetMangaInfosThread.pas:168-191).

cache_size_mb.description:
Size cap of the cover cache in MiB; least recently used covers are evicted past it.
Minimum 1.

revalidate_after_hours.description:
Hours a cached cover is served before the site is asked whether it changed; 0 asks every
time.

DatabaseSize.description: The size of one database in the data dir.

bytes.description: The database file plus its write-ahead log; `null` when the file does not exist.

auto_download.description: Queue new chapters automatically (`update/AutoCheckFavAutoDownload`, default false).

current_chapter.description: Chapters on the site at the last check (FMD2's `currentchapter`).

last_updated.description: RFC 3339: when a check last found new chapters.

link.description: The series link relative to the module's `RootURL`.

new_chapters.description:
Chapters on the site at the last check that are not downloaded: the chapter count less
the downloaded ones, as only the count of the site's list is stored. Downloaded chapters
the site no longer lists make it an undercount; a check finds the real ones by link.

website.description: The module's name; its ID when the module is not loaded.

new_chapters.description: New (or missing) chapters found, once finished.

field.description: The setting as a dotted path, like [`Problem::field`].

add_as_stopped.description:

data_dir.description:
Folder for the list databases, relative to the app data directory (`DATA_FOLDER`,

lua_dir.description: Folder holding the Lua tree (`LUA_REPO_FOLDER`, baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:297).

auth.description: Whether the API requires the password (as a bearer token or a login session).

cookies.description:
Cookies merged into every request (`HTTP.Cookies`,

user_agent.description: Replaces the default user agent when non-empty.

dry_run.description: Nothing was written; the counts say what would have been imported.

unmapped.description: FMD2 data FMD2r has no place for.

warnings.description:

Limit overrides; 0 means "not overridden" for tasks and threads

max_connection_limit.description:
Replaces the module's connection limit while enabled, 0 (unlimited) included
